items.title: 61530_Roy Eldridge oral history interview
items.q: Yeah. And it was ridiculous, man.

ctx.x: Yeah. And it was ridiculous, man. They was playing all that fast, and the things they were playing, they were just trying to figure out something fast to play, and every once in a while they'd have to stop and hold a note and...heh-heh... Of course, that was a long time ago, but hell, it still was that same thing about playing that fast, you know. Because I tried to keep the string going, you know, but not with the same thing or repeating the same thing. And I couldn't play no blues.
There wasn't any blues in the shows that you worked on?
